# 00000003144

**English.** Definition: The Lie group side of Hirota: the symmetry structure of integrable systems. Conjecture: The Kac–Moody generation of symmetries: higher symmetries of integrable hierarchies are generated by the principal vertex of an affine algebra, and the commutation of generation is the Heisenberg subalgebra. (Kac-Moody principal vertex Heisenberg)

**中文。** 定义：Hirota 的李群侧：可积系统的对称结构。猜想：对称的 Kac–Moody 生成：可积层级的高阶对称为仿射代数的主顶点生成且生成的交换为 Heisenberg 子代数。（Kac-Moody 主顶点 Heisenberg）
